title: Polynomial size in layered circuits
statement: Let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings. If $L$ is recognized by a well-formed Boolean circuit family with fan-in at most two and size at most $a(n+1)^k$ on inputs of length $n$, for some natural numbers $a,k$, then $L$ is recognized by a finite-layered circuit family using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates, with size at most $a'(n+1)^{k'}$ for some natural numbers $a',k'$.
hypotheses_covered: There are natural numbers $a,k$ such that $L$ is in circuit size at most $a(n+1)^k$ with fan-in at most two
